steam.store_details: The original build, without the NewDark engine patch.
steam.patches: T2Fix bundles the NewDark engine patch along with a range of modern-system fixes, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

gog.store_details: It comes with the NewDark engine patch pre-installed.

audio_fixes.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Some Thief II maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there (per NewDark's documentation).

extra_fixes.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
extra_fixes.reason: Thief II reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision (per NewDark's documentation).
